SCRATCHPAD.ShapeTool: Sketch Shapes (Shift to snap; Polygon: click corners, click start to close, double-click to end, Esc to cancel)
SCRATCHPAD.TextTool: Sketch Text (Enter = new line, Ctrl+Enter = done)
SCRATCHPAD.Lasso: Lasso / Click Select (Shift to add, drag to move, Delete to remove)
SCRATCHPAD.Eraser: Eraser (partial cuts lines, whole deletes drawings)
SCRATCHPAD.Private: Private (only you can see new drawings)
SCRATCHPAD.LayerDeleteConfirm: Delete layer "{name}"? Its drawings move to "{target}".
SCRATCHPAD.LayerLastWarn: A scene needs at least one layer.
SCRATCHPAD.LayerRenameHint: Click to draw on this layer; double-click to rename
SCRATCHPAD.LayerMoveSelection: Move lasso selection to the active layer
SCRATCHPAD.LayerBadgeHint: New drawings go on this layer. Click to manage layers.
SCRATCHPAD.BakeHint: Renders the scene background and all visible, non-private drawings into one new background image. The original background is remembered in the scene's flags.
SCRATCHPAD.BakeTiles: Include tiles (and remove them after baking)
SCRATCHPAD.BakeRemove: Remove the baked drawings (undo with Ctrl+Z)
SCRATCHPAD.BakeDone: Drawings baked into the scene background.
SCRATCHPAD.CardTool: Board Card (click to add or edit)
SCRATCHPAD.StringTool: Board String (drag card to card; again to cut)
SCRATCHPAD.CardHint: Click empty space for a new card, or a card to edit it
SCRATCHPAD.StringHint: Drag from one card to another
SCRATCHPAD.Heading: Heading
